suppressions.title: Suppressions
suppressions.description: Inspect per-address block reasons, scopes, and evidence; add blocks or request releases.
suppressions.emptyDescription: Suppressions are scoped per purpose; release requires separate approval.
suppressions.addressInvalid: Not a valid email address format.

add.title: Add suppression
add.description: Block sending to this address within the selected scope. Complaints and hard bounces may warrant an all-purpose block (§11.1).
add.evidencePlaceholder: e.g. ticket ID, opt-out intake source
add.evidenceHint: Record what justifies this block — manual entry, an external intake channel, etc.

release.title: Request suppression release
release.description: Releases are not applied from this screen. Your request goes to a separate approver with reason and evidence.
release.reasonPlaceholder: Why should this suppression be released?
release.evidencePlaceholder: e.g. recipient consent document, ticket link
release.evidenceHint: An approver needs evidence they can verify before releasing.
release.approvalNote: This does not release the block directly. Even after approval, sending stays impossible if other active reasons remain.

errors.title: Could not process
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this first. Check the latest state.
errors.idempotencyReused: A different request with the same key was detected. Try again.
errors.inProgress: The same request is still being processed. Check back shortly.
errors.generic: Could not process the request. Please try again.

syncStatus.loadFailed: Could not check external sync status. Retry to read the status again.
syncStatus.notConnected: No external connection is configured for this suppression.
syncStatus.unknownDescription: Office has no confirmed external result. This screen does not confirm the service updated and will not resubmit the change.

reviews.title: Basis reviews
reviews.description: Review per-purpose and per-jurisdiction communication bases and evidence; decide validity or revoke.
reviews.emptyDescription: A new basis is not valid until a person reviews it — a checkbox alone cannot make consent valid.

review.title: Review basis
review.description: Mark valid only after personally verifying the evidence. A checkbox alone cannot make consent valid.
review.evidenceHint: Open the evidence reference and verify the actual basis before deciding.
review.validUntilHint: When marking valid you may set an expiry time.
review.reasonPlaceholder: What you verified, or the rejection reason

revoke.title: Revoke basis
revoke.description: Revoking stops sends that rely on this basis.
revoke.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this basis being revoked?

reviews.conflict: This basis was already reviewed or modified. Check the latest state.

errors.conflict: Someone else changed this first. Check the latest state.
errors.idempotencyReused: A different request with the same key was detected. Try again.
errors.inProgress: The same request is still being processed. Check back shortly.
errors.generic: Could not process the request. Please try again.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.description: Nothing changes until you press the button below. Opening this page does nothing.

scope.workspace_marketing: All marketing email from this organization

unsubscribe.footnote: Processed immediately without sign-in. Pressing again gives the same result.
unsubscribe.doneDescription: Office saved your unsubscribe as a local block. The external email service will reflect this asynchronously; this page does not confirm that update.
unsubscribe.invalidDescription: The link is expired or invalid. Use the latest unsubscribe link from the email you received.
unsubscribe.loadError: Could not verify the link. Please try again.
unsubscribe.submitError: Could not process the unsubscribe. Please try again.
